dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.resetConfirm: Go back to the default dashboard? You can undo it.
dashboard.editHint: Drag the dividers to resize. In grids, drag a card by its header and resize it from the corner. Everything is saved to your Zentico UI files.
dashboard.emptyBody: Add widgets or ask {agent} to set it up for you.

typeHints.agenda: Your events today and the next few days.
typeHints.mail: Unread mail or the results of a search.
typeHints.chat: Conversations with unread messages, or one conversation's latest messages.
typeHints.drive: Recent files or the contents of a folder.
typeHints.notes: Markdown text stored in the widget.
typeHints.clock: The time here or in several time zones.
typeHints.chart: A number, or a bar or line chart of your data.
typeHints.custom: Custom HTML, CSS and JS (usually made by {agent}), isolated from the rest.
typeHints.mail_thread: Reads the conversation selected in a mail list, with quick actions.
typeHints.chat_conversation: One chat conversation with a message box.
typeHints.calendar_week: Your week as a calendar grid.
typeHints.drive_folder: The contents of one Drive folder.
typeHints.doc_markdown: A Markdown file from your Drive, rendered.
typeHints.meetings_next: Your next meeting with a countdown and Join.
typeHints.claude: Your own {agent}, right in the layout.

menu.label: Widget options
menu.publishMod: Publish this mod to the gallery

widget.customEscaped: This widget tried to leave the dashboard and was stopped.

config.title: Configure {type}
config.linksHint: One per line: Name | https://… (or a path like /drive).
config.zonesHint: One per line: Name | Europe/Madrid. Empty = your local time.
config.chartHint: kind: bar, line or number; labels; series: [{ name, values }]; value, delta, unit, caption.
config.htmlHint: Runs isolated, without network access. Read data with await zentico.query(name, args). Max 100 KB.

chat.title: {agent}
chat.needToken: You need a read+write access token to talk to your {agent}.
chat.bridgeOff: Your agent bridge isn't running: messages will wait.
chat.emptyBody: Your dashboard is made of files in your Drive (Zentico UI). {agent} can add pages and apps, rearrange them, change the theme and shortcuts, and build mods. Changes show up live and can be undone.
chat.example1: Add a page with my team channel and this week's calendar, pinned to the rail
chat.example2: Build a mod that tracks my daily habits
chat.example3: Turn the Focus page into its own app with a dark green accent
chat.expired: That confirmation is no longer available.
chat.placeholder: Ask for a change or a question…
chat.private: Only you see this conversation. It runs on your own agent, on your computer.

workspace.restoreConfirm: Restore the default look and layout of the workspace? Your current customization is backed up and you can undo it.
workspace.restored: Default UI restored. You can undo it from “Customize with {agent}”.
workspace.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore right now. Opening the safe page…
workspace.presetApplied: Theme applied to the whole workspace
workspace.issues: Your UI customization has {n, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}: that part uses the last valid version or the defaults.
workspace.fixPrompt: My workspace customization (theme.json / ui.json shell) has validation errors. Please fix them.
workspace.safeOn: Safe mode: your customizations are off in this browser.
examples: Make the whole workspace more compact
Put my tasks panel next to this app
Use a dark blue accent and rounder corners everywhere
workspace.safeBody: If a customization made the workspace hard to use, restore the defaults here. Your current files are backed up first, so you can undo it later. Safe mode shows the workspace without your theme and shell customization, in this browser only.
workspace.safeEnter: Open the workspace in safe mode
workspace.safeActive: Safe mode is on in this browser.
